It waxes poetic in some places, philosophical in others, and moves several members of the court to tears with the sheer beauty of its prose. But the gist of the message is that [rival] is in need of aid and wishes us to send them some.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Poor Quality Copper

options.text: They should restore your money in full!
If you want to take them, take them. If not, go away.

events.text: An ambassador has arrived from [rival] asking us to end our friendly relations with [rival] due to their unscrupulous merchants who have delivered poor quality copper ingots. “They treat our messengers with contempt!” he says, “On account of the one trifling mina of silver which we owe them, they feel free to speak to us in such a way!”

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Problem Child

options.text: Send him to [rival] as a permanent "ambassador."
Occupy him with a worthwhile position.
Leave him alone. After all, he is family.

events.text: Once again, your brother has made an ass of himself in the eyes of the public. Something about a fish, a wine bottle, and a stable fire... The court is furious! [character] has always been the family outcast, but his antics are starting to cause lasting damage to your reputation.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Progress or Perish

options.text: We must build on foundations of science.
[rival] has its way, and we have ours.
She must come teach us in [rival].

events.text: The court hosts a visiting engineer from [rival], who is renowned for her work on the nation's wonders. She marvels at our nation's progress but questions our reliance on philosophy and mysticism. "Engineering is the key to unlocking the universe," she says. "With it, we move mountains."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Proof of Friendship

options.text: I will show you the value of our friendship.
My devotion will not be bought.
Cede [rival] some recently acquired territory.
Assign troops for security duties in [rival].

events.text: Our recent actions have inspired a strong reaction from [rival]. So it is no surprise when a personal message from [character] reaches the palace. He worries that your vision for [rival] grows cloudy. "We must align, for our own good and the good of the world." It sounds as though he requires proof of your friendship.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Quality Time

options.text: I will stay close to my host, [character].
I wish to know [character] better.
I will win over both of them.

events.text: In response to our gracious support of [rival] during its struggles, [character] has extended an invitation. He would be honored if you would visit the royal palace and speak before the gathered [rival] court, a high honor. During your visit, the heir to [rival]'s throne, [character], offers to act as your escort. This may be a good chance to win over the next generation of [rival] leadership, but it would mean ignoring the current ruler.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Religious Ironography

options.text: Allow this, but take a tithe.
Seize these trinkets!

events.text: Convoys from [rival] have arrived in [city]. They contain a vast number of trinkets, cast in iron, representing [religion]. Missionaries are handing them out to anyone who agrees to convert.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Resupply

outcomes.label: Diplo Offer Ask Favor Yes Money
Diplo Offer Ask Favor Yes Food
Diplo Offer Ask Favor Yes Iron
Diplo Offer Ask Favor Yes Wood

options.text: placeholder
Sadly, we are in no position to give aid.

events.text: Recent [rival] wars have left [character] with a severe need to re-equip his army before the next campaigning season begins. Iron, wood, food, or gold would be welcomely received!

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Returning a Favor

options.text: Your gratitude is all we need.

events.text: Envoys from [rival] return to the capital, hoping to repay our favor. They have given us a choice of rewards from their finest traders.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: River Contamination

options.text: It was a harmless mistake, let them go.
They must pay for their crimes.
They will be tried before representatives from both sides.

events.text: Some [rival] merchants visiting the city of [city] were recently found washing themselves in the river. It is a great insult in [religion] to contaminate a natural source of water and the people of [city] are demanding justice. [rival] has asked for their people to be returned and tensions are rising. What judgment will you pass?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Road to Heaven

options.text: Sacred teachings are free to all.
They will understand... when they are ready.

events.text: A procession of ragged [rival] holy men enters the capital, searching for a sign from their divine masters. These seekers wish to prove their worthiness, and they hope to study under our holiest advisors. Shall we share our spiritual secrets?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Safe Passage

options.text: She is welcome in our kingdom.
Diplomacy forbids us from action.
Smuggle her with goods on the supply road.

events.text: Our spies report that a renowned poet in [rival] has been targeted for her rebellious views. She wishes to escape [rival] and seek refuge in our kingdom. Granting asylum to this person would garner us much goodwill, but it would put us at odds with their ruler. Shall we grant her safe passage?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Sanskrit Diplomacy

options.text: We must make the most of the opportunity to strengthen cultural ties.
Let us bind our kingdoms together in Peace Player.

events.text: The use of Sanskrit by your scribes has led to a surprising development: Relations with [rival] have been steadily improving, with the language acting as a common bridge between the two kingdoms.

events.author: Soren Johnson / Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Seeking Knowledge

options.text: Share our knowledge of [tech] with [rival] in hopes that they one day return the favor.
It would not be wise at this point to share state secrets.

events.text: Word of our knowledge of [tech] has traveled far. An emissary representing [character] arrives at court, humbly requesting that we share with [rival] what we know.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Seeking Knowledge

options.text: Iron for tools and weapons.
Food for the people.
Stone for homes, shrines, and monuments.
We wish to keep our discoveries to ourselves.

events.text: A caravan of [rival] scholars wish to observe our great scribes and scientists. They show interest in our many technological advancements, and they will trade for any knowledge we are open to sharing. What can we use?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Shared Interests

options.text: Send scholars to [rival] to teach [character].
I refuse a gift, but I will gladly accept the compliments.
Take the advisor captive as a scholar for the court.

requirements.label: Cruel / Spoiled / Foolish / Insane
tip: The leader must have one of: Cruel; Spoiled; Foolish; Insane

options.text: Burn the texts and send them back to [rival].

events.text: A visiting [rival] scholar falls before the throne, flattering you with tales of [rival]'s envy. According to him, [character] aspires to emulate your leadership, knowledge, and tolerance. "You are both searchers for the truth. It is right that you be companions on this journey." The [rival] advisor bestows upon you a gift of ancient texts, a sign of [character]'s friendship.

events.author: Soren Johnson / Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Sharing Knowledge

options.text: A mutual sharing of knowledge will benefit us both.
We appreciate the offer, but [rival] would prefer to focus on our own affairs right now.

events.text: An emissary arrives from our friends in [rival], where word of our scientific advancement has spread. [rival] scholars offer to teach us what they know of [tech] if we are willing to share our knowledge of [tech]. How shall we respond?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Sharing the Loot

options.text: Slaves to work the fields.
Gems from a looted tomb.
Cryptic scrolls and carvings.
Let [character] keep it all for himself.

events.text: The forces of [rival] have recently sacked a barbarian encampment, and they find themselves flush with plunder. [character] wishes to offer us some of the spoils, as a gesture of his ongoing friendship. We have our choice of treasure.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Show Respect

options.text: Our people should not be forced to obey your customs.
In this court, all bow to me, [character].

events.text: Seeking to improve relations, [character], the [title] of [rival] arrives to address the court. During introductions, he insists that members of our court kneel to kiss his feet, as is customary in [rival]. The heads of our noble houses passionately object to this request. As a grumble of discontent passes through the crowd, [character] looks to you for a decision.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Special Guest

options.text: I will be happy to meet with the architects if we can get some spare construction material.
Let us discuss city planning over some drinks. Then maybe we can all learn something.
Matters here require my attention. I must sadly decline the invitation.

events.text: The [rival] city of [city] is about to hold a week-long festival that is expected to attract people from far beyond the city's borders. To celebrate our friendship, [rival] envoys pass a message inviting you to the [city] festival as a special guest. As a famed Builder Archetype, there are many aspiring architects eager to meet you, as well as officials looking to discuss city planning.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Special Guest

options.text: I can teach their soldiers a thing or two.
I have a better idea. I will duel any willing man or beast in [city]. That will be quite the sight!
Matters here require my attention. I must sadly decline the invitation.

events.text: The [rival] city of [city] is about to hold a week-long festival that is expected to attract people from far beyond the city's borders. To celebrate our friendship, [rival] envoys pass a message inviting you to the [city] festival as a special guest. The military of [rival] holds you in high respect as an inspiring Hero Archetype. Training alongside you would be considered a great honor, if you're willing to take the time.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Special Guest

options.text: I will hold a public lecture from which anyone can learn.
A seminar with the most renowned scientists of [rival] seems in order.
Matters here require my attention. I must sadly decline the invitation.

events.text: The [rival] city of [city] is about to hold a week-long festival that is expected to attract people from far beyond the city's borders. To celebrate our friendship, [rival] envoys pass a message inviting you to the [city] festival as a special guest. Your reputation as a Scholar Archetype precedes you. The intellectuals of [rival] are anticipating your visit, and young students in [city] are hoping for a chance to learn from you.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Spicy Scheme

options.text: They simply should not allow themselves to be tricked.
Ban this sophistry!

events.text: Missionary agents from [rival] are causing upheaval in [city]. Citizens are being duped into signing up for a chance to win a bushel of saffron, but only after they have inscribed their mark are they informed that they have also agreed to convert to [religion].

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Spouse vs. Ambassador

options.text: I agree with my spouse [character]. Peace with the [rival] is insufferable.
The Ambassador is right. I will maintain the Peace.
We cannot compromise our Peace with the [rival] on the whim of any one person.

events.text: Your spouse, [character], and Ambassador, [character], have lately been disagreeing about our diplomatic approach toward the [rival]. [character] has had enough of the Peace with [character], whom he so despises. [character] would prefer to maintain our current good relations. Should we conform with the wishes of [character] and break off our Peace with the [rival]?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Suspected Spy

options.text: I have faith in the judgement of the [family].
Free this man and return him to [rival].
We must work together to fix this misunderstanding.

events.text: One of our agents in the [family] household reports that a prisoner is being held secretly in the family dungeon. The captive is an ambassador from [rival] who encountered overzealous [family] guards on the road to the capital. They subdued him and are now holding him as a spy. We should expect to receive an angry message from [rival] any day now.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Take Another Husband?

options.text: This is a political marriage, and [character] will understand.
I do not wish to upset [character], so I must refuse.

events.text: A glorious delegation from [rival] arrives in the capital with a marriage proposal. They wish for you to wed [character], a worthy [rival] groom. We should consider it carefully as it may upset [character].

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: The Best of Friends

options.text: Cordially accept.
Make clear that enough is enough.
Make a convincing excuse.

events.text: [character] has formally requested a meeting for the "imperative discussion of numerous shared [rival] and [rival] issues." Again. You would think [character] would have better things to do. Is he really that bored, or does he just enjoy pulling your strings?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Bias of Faith

options.text: [character] is [rival]’s puppet.
[rival] must be shown the error of their ways.

events.text: [rival] has outright accused [character] of favoring [rival], diverting religious resources to his home nation. Outraged by the suggestion, be it true or false, [character] demands that you go to war with [rival] to show your dedication to the [religion] cause. He promises to do everything in his power to reinforce your legitimacy to your subjects if you agree.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Charity of Ahura Mazda

options.text: We will send out donations of food to the people.
My allies the [rival] deserve my generosity.
No, it’s all mine.

events.text: The teachings of [religion] encourage humility and generosity, even from a [title]. [character] has sent a Magus claiming to have had a message from Ahura Mazda, asking you for donations of food from the royal stockpiles.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Debt of Science

options.text: Let us make this an equal trade between friends.
Accept this repayment.
Hold on to the favor, for now...

events.text: A message arrives from [character], carried by a collection of regally-dressed learned men and women. [character] offers a gift of technology to clear the debt that is owed, offering the accompanying scholars to teach us of the [rival] discoveries. Will you accept this proposal?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: The Enemy of my Friend is my Friend

options.text: Perhaps this could persuade you to reconsider?
Consider it done.
No one makes demands of [rival]!

events.text: An emissary from [rival] brings dire news. Their relationship with [rival] has worsened to the point where they feel unable to maintain friendly relations with us due to our friendship with [character]. “How can you tolerate that <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_ZEALOT>pious fool<p=SUBJECT_SCHOLAR>bookish intellectual<p=SUBJECT_ORATOR>rambling windbag<p=SUBJECT_DIPLOMAT>worm-tongued manipulator<p=SUBJECT_SCHEMER>scheming sneak<p=SUBJECT_HERO>puffed up braggart<p=SUBJECT_TACTICIAN>conceited bore<p=SUBJECT_COMMANDER>military-obsessed fanatic<p=SUBJECT_BUILDER>tinkering obsessive<p=SUBJECT_JUDGE>judgemental type<else>bore with no personality<end>, [character]?” asks the emissary, “We must demand that you denounce him immediately!”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: The Enemy of my Friend is my Friend

options.text: Anything for such a good friend!
We conduct our own diplomacy.

events.text: An emissary from [rival] brings an urgent request. Their relationship with [rival] has worsened to the point where they feel that they must ask us to end our friendship with [character]. “How can you tolerate that <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_ZEALOT>pious fool<p=SUBJECT_SCHOLAR>bookish intellectual<p=SUBJECT_ORATOR>rambling windbag<p=SUBJECT_DIPLOMAT>worm-tongued manipulator<p=SUBJECT_SCHEMER>scheming sneak<p=SUBJECT_HERO>puffed up braggart<p=SUBJECT_TACTICIAN>conceited bore<p=SUBJECT_COMMANDER>military-obsessed fanatic<p=SUBJECT_BUILDER>tinkering obsessive<p=SUBJECT_JUDGE>judgemental type<else>bore with no personality<end>, [character]?” asks the emissary, “We must request that you denounce him immediately, and we're prepared to make it worth your while.”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Four-Fold Path

options.text: We will start with Sama. The first step is always to talk.
Proceed with Dana. Gifts of co-operation will secure our friendship.
We must rely on the trickery of Bheda, using discord to sow chaos.
Danda is the only path forwards. It must be war.

events.text: Sama, Dana, Bheda, Dandopaya. The phrase encompassing the four routes to resolving a conflict plays through your mind as [character] envoy and [character] argue back and forth, yet again. Is there a path to peace for your two nations?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Last Piece

options.text: Very well, he is yours!
We refuse to part with [character].
Send your agents to steal their research for [character] to complete.

events.text: [rival] is on the brink of a breakthrough. However, they claim that they need [character] specialist knowledge of to complete their work. They claim that if we permit [character] to join them to complete the work, then they will share the knowledge with us once completed. Will you accept this unusual offer?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Price of [city]

options.text: Agree to trade [city] for an alliance.
Trade the city for help in the war.
Decline the diplomatic offer.

events.text: How much is [city] worth? A group of [rival] diplomats have arrived, offering to form an alliance or to enter the war with [rival] if you would be willing to give up the city. What answer will you give to [character] emissaries?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Rant

options.text: I want nothing to do with this madman.
Perhaps we can earn his favor with support.
What odd metaphor [character] uses! Still, a lovely sentiment, I must write him in kind.
Write a reply that sows his further paranoia.

events.text: You receive a personal message from [character], but it is little more than a confusing, insult-laden rant against our nation, broken only by threats. Sheepishly, the messenger explains that his ruler is not known for a "clear head" in matters of diplomacy.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Runaway Prince

options.text: Return [character] to [rival]. This is a family affair, not ours.
Conceal [character], and provide him with whatever he needs.
Return [character] and claim he attempted to sell [rival] secrets.

events.text: Late one evening, there is a knock at your door. [character], heir to the [rival] throne, stands outside. The young prince has fled his palace with hopes of escaping his responsibilities. He wishes to hide from his father's agents in [rival] and start a new life here. It is only a matter of time before [rival] soldiers arrive at our gates.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Sacred City

options.text: We will not fight against other [religion].

events.text: [rival] supports the [religion] ways, officially accepting them as a central part of daily life. However, the idea that the Holy City of [city] lies outside of your borders is a point of contention; the Priests of [rival] argue that ours is the one true nation of the faith and that it is only right that the city should be under your control. Will you set your sights on the holy city?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Schism

options.text: We will stand with [rival].
[rival] has our support.

events.text: The three great nations of [rival], [rival], and [rival] have stood united in the grace of [religion]. But no longer. Arguments over the nature of [theology] in the core tenets of the religion have created insurmountable rifts in the understanding of the divine, and [rival] and [rival] are completely divided. The slightest provocation could lead to war. Both nations look to you as the deciding factor, demanding that you support their arguments.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: The Slave Trade

options.text: Accept [character]'s deal.
Trick him, providing more slaves but only the ill and injured.
Maybe I should go home and rethink my life.

events.text: [character] sends his regards to you, his most amoral of peers. The labor situation in [rival] has grown rather dire, and [character] wishes to procure laborers from our nation without all the fuss and bother that normally accompany such deals. Knowing that you are a reasonable man, he is certain we can reach an appropriately generous agreement with ample compensation for you.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Tit for Tat

options.text: This seems like a fair trade.
No, we will make our discoveries.

events.text: Our mounted scouts have crossed paths with riders from [rival], and the two groups discussed their techniques. The [rival] riders believe we would benefit from learning the ways of Stirrups. All they ask in return is an improved arrow design. Will we authorize this trade?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Token of Goodwill

options.text: Accept this gift of knowledge.
We will not be bribed.
If you want it, you must show me your latest works.

events.text: A chest of gold arrives atop a litter carried by handsome [rival] servants. It is a gift from [character]. "Consider this a token of goodwill," says a scroll accompanying the treasure. "Perhaps you will feel compelled to share a token of your own. Perhaps knowledge of the Spoked Wheel?"

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Trade Offer

options.text: For now, we prefer not to trade.

events.text: Court merchants have arrived from [rival] with an offer of trade. They believe our nations would grow and prosper from improved trade relations. What is our response?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Trade-Off

options.text: The reward is worth the risk.
The [family] are right. We must be cautious.
Offer to pay for the technology instead.

events.text: The [rival] ambassador waits patiently for your reply, watching in quiet bemusement as the leaders of the [family] and [family] shout over each other to be heard. The proposed offer is that [rival] would like to exchange technologies as a sign of friendship. However, they have asked to learn about our military advancements in return for their own economic knowledge. The [family] family argue that the economic benefits would greatly help our nation, while the [family] warn of the dangers of arming [rival] with a more advanced military.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Unbidden

options.text: Go as you are.
Invest in your appearance.
Make an excuse to cancel.

events.text: Something about the way [character] looks at you always makes your breath catch. His gaze makes you feel elation and dread in equal measure, as though being judged by a God. And now, a diplomatic meeting has been proposed. He would arrive in days.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Under Suspicion

options.text: Accuse [rival] of preparing for war.
Approach with caution and openness.
Offer better trade terms to ease tensions.

events.text: During a recent visit, the [rival] Ambassador acts strangely in our presence. She asks too many probing questions, and is always turning to whisper something to her retinue. As tensions rise, we worry that [rival] may be planning a surprise strike. Are we simply jumping at shadows?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Under [city]

options.text: Unearth the ancient ruins.
Search for mines to restore.
They would be of more use in our court.
I have no interest in chasing myths.

events.text: Scientists from [rival] arrive in court unannounced, sent by [character]. These foreign masters have been studying ancient drawings of the region, and they have reason to believe there may be ruins, mines, or even buried vaults beneath the city of [city]. Knowing how our nations are on good terms, the scientists seek permission to excavate.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Unexpected Connections

options.text: Their people hold us in high esteem.
Not right now.

events.text: Unexpected personal connections have opened up a direct channel to the leaders of [rival] or [rival]. The court seeks to improve relations with both nations, but we should proceed with caution. Shall we move forward with [rival] or [rival]?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Unlawful

options.text: We will fight because the cause is just.
Your grievances do not justify bloodshed.

events.text: After days of tense, private discussion, members of the [family] family emerge with a decree. They wish for us to wage a righteous war on [rival]. "The [rival] practice the abhorrent law of [law], which we must no longer tolerate. The time to take up arms is at hand."

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Unlawful

options.text: I will put a plan in motion.
Your grievances do not justify bloodshed.

events.text: After days of tense, private discussion, members of the [family] family emerge with a decree. They wish for us to wage a righteous war on [rival]. "The [rival] practice the abhorrent law of [law], which we must no longer tolerate. The time to take up arms is at hand."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Unpaid Debts

options.text: Coin debasement will make gold go farther.
Pay off the loans from the royal coffers.
Refuse to give the [rival] any support.

events.text: It has come to our attention that the [family] Family accepted loans from the [rival] to fund projects. Now, those [rival] are demanding repayment of the debt. The court erupts in a great debate over where to find the money. What shall we say?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Visiting Prince

options.text: Prepare to host the [rival] prince.
Refuse the royal retinue.

events.text: A message arrives from [character]. His brother, [character], who has been traveling, will pass [city] in the coming months. Would we consider hosting him at the local palace and exhibiting some traditional [rival] hospitality? We should be careful. [city] has a notoriously outspoken population. Displays of foreign wealth may chasten.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: War Demand

options.text: We must wage war on [rival].
Let's wait awhile, and see how things play out.

events.text: The sudden arrival of envoys from [rival] causes disorder in the court. Their ruler, [character], demands that we take up arms against [rival]. This is not a decision to be considered lightly. What shall we do?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: War Demand

options.text: We must wage war on [tribe].
Let's wait awhile, and see how things play out.

events.text: An entourage of grim ambassadors arrive from [rival]. They bring a message from their ruler, [character]. He demands that we declare war against their enemy, the [tribe]. How shall we respond to this ultimatum?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: War Games

outcomes.label: Diplo Offer Ask Favor Yes Training
Diplo Offer Ask Favor Yes Money
Diplo Offer Ask Favor Yes Orders

options.text: placeholder
Sadly, we are in no position to give aid.

events.text: [character] requests a boon from us. Recent campaigns have left [rival] short on trained manpower, and [character] would be very grateful if we would lend him some of our veterans to train his men.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Windmills and Watermills

options.text: The secrets of Vaulting.
Knowledge of the Lateen Sail.
Sorry, we can't make a deal.

events.text: If you'd like to build Windmill and Watermill, you will need Hydraulics. [character] is willing to trade it to you for one of these discoveries.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: World Tour

options.text: We desire knowledge for knowledge.
Yes, but hold our first festival in [city].
Our great works should stay in [rival].

events.text: Plays from our finest dramatists have been touring friendly cities across the world. Now other nations clamor for more enriching cultural works from their own artists. Envoys from [rival] arrive in court, hoping to learn from our masters. Are we willing to share the secrets of Drama?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Wrath of the [family]

options.text: We have been chosen, and we will fight.
Your grievances do not justify bloodshed.

events.text: The [family] family cannot contain its rage. They assemble in court to insist that, in the name of [religion], the nation declare war on [rival] for its unnatural [religion] beliefs. "We will not abide such a repugnant, unnatural faith!" How shall we respond?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Wrath of the [family]

options.text: We have been chosen, and we will fight.
Your grievances do not justify bloodshed.

events.text: The [family] family cannot contain its rage. They assemble in court to insist that, in the name of [religion], the nation declare war on [rival] for its unnatural [religion] beliefs. "We will not abide such a repugnant, unnatural faith!" How shall we respond?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Zealots at the Gates

options.text: Then convert they must!
We do not fear flatulence.

events.text: Missionaries from [rival] have arrived in [city]. They bring the word of the Zealot Archetype [character], who demands that [city] accept [religion], lest fire smite it from the sky and a plague of flatulence beset its citizens.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] Barter

options.text: This opportunity can't be missed!
Refuse the deal, but praise [character] effort.

events.text: [character] rushes up to you, almost tripping over his own feet in his excitement. During a recent visit to [rival], [character] managed to secure a deal with [character]. The nation, in dire need of financing, is willing to part with some of their scientific findings in return for payment. Will you take up this offer?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: [character] the [rival]

options.text: Accept. It is wise to host an agent of the [rival] court.
Refuse. This foreigner is much too eager to help us.
Welcome him warmly, and appoint him to a court position.

events.text: [character], a member of the [rival] court, arrives with a special request. He wishes to remain in [city] as a foreign ambassador, living among our people while supporting the cause of his fellow [rival] abroad. Granting such a position to a foreigner, including a palatial home and court access, may anger some of the citizens of [city], but it would certainly bolster relations with [rival].

events.author: Solver
events.name: [religion] Pilgrims

options.text: Divert extra supplies to [city] so that the pilgrims are taken care of.
Have soldiers maintain public order. They can charge the visitors for our hospitality, too.
[city] is not one big inn. Turn the pilgrims away.
They'll just have to find a way to get along.

events.text: A band of [religion] pilgrims from [rival] is traveling to the holy city of [city]. Our scouts report that the pilgrims are numerous. Some of them are entire families hoping to have their newborns blessed in [city]. The arrival of so many people at once is causing great concern in [city] and will surely cause difficulties unless we step in.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: [rival] Calls for Aid!

options.text: Let slip the dogs of war!
Let's wait awhile, and see how things play out.

events.text: Exhausted by their war with the treacherous [rival], our close ally [rival] has sent to us for aid. Will we live up to the terms of our alliance, and ride out to help them?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: [rival] Calls for Aid!

options.text: We will join you to wipe out the [tribe]!
Surely you can handle these [tribe] Tribe yourself?

events.text: Exhausted by the incessant raids of the barbarous [tribe], our close ally [rival] has sent to us for aid. Will we uphold the obligations of our alliance, and ride out to help them?

events.name: [rival] [religion]

options.text: Adopt these new ideas and encode them in your nation's [religion] doctrine.
Evade making any commitments.
Denounce [character] perversions of the faith.

events.text: [character], a fellow [religion], is visiting on a diplomatic visit, accompanied by a procession of and seers. Discussing the faith, there are a surprising number of differences between how is worshiped in your different nations. The [title] talks at length about the idea of dualism and how the physical and spiritual worlds are separate. He suggests that together you could shape the path of your shared religion. Your own court are skeptical about the idea.
